input.summary: Lumber Hall, between-parts pass: make.sh passes and build.nbt is whole. Fixed the pavement (56 dark cells to 0, four lamp posts added), and the off-palette counter block (smooth_stone_slab to polished_andesite_slab via sockets.json fitout). Not fixed: six keeper pockets (A1-A3, B1-B3) still read "no way in", because the walker treats the open hatch trapdoors as solid, so the verdict is a toolkit gap rather than a build fault.
left: Six pocket rooms still UNREACHABLE in mcd walk (A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3; walk ok:false). Cause: the keeper hatches (11,12,16) (19,12,16) (27,12,16) (15,12,21) (23,12,21) (31,12,21) are open dark_oak_trapdoor blocks, and rooms.mjs PASS has no trapdoor entry, so the walker treats them as solid. Proof: clearing those six cells in a copy (/tmp, build untouched) made all six pockets 6/6 reached and walk ok:true. The game passes open trapdoors, so I believe the pockets are reachable in play, but I could not run the game to confirm. I did not change the plan's trapdoor hatches to holes, and did not edit the shared toolkit. Decision needed: (a) teach rooms.mjs and room-check.mjs that an open trapdoor is passable, or (b) make the six hatch cells plain holes. The sockets check's 12 'keeper can't reach' warnings have the same root cause.

Version mismatch: the file's DataVersion is 4189 (1.21.4), where the chain block id is 'chain'. The palette and the hoist/lantern chains (room-1, room-3, room-8, room-12, frame hoistBeam via IRON_CHAIN) use 'iron_chain', which mcd info flags as unknown. Palette rules say keep iron_chain, so this needs a project decision (pin the target version to 26.x, or change the palette). Not changed.
mcd check reports 22 orphans, all designed shop counters (polished_andesite_slab, double, at y5 in front of each payment hopper). They are supported and not floating, so I left them.

waste.cost: 2 tool calls, plus reconciling the two version answers by hand

waste.what: Viewed the sheet and rooms renders and judged the rooms and facades by eye. Nothing in them needed a fix beyond the walk and light findings.
waste.tool: mcd rooms could flag rooms whose box is partly empty or whose furniture is cramped, so the eye check is a list, not a scan.
